verdict.rationale: No export feature is documented. Some user data does live in open, portable formats: projects are plain local folders and Git repos/worktrees, skills are folders with a SKILL.md file, artifacts are markdown plans and diffs, and the headless CLI can emit machine-readable output. One community report says conversation history was lost entirely during the 2.0 upgrade, which suggests history is not easily kept or carried out. Missing for 10: a documented full-account/data export (conversation history, settings, artifacts), a stated export format, and independent confirmation that users can leave with all their data.
